# Viruses

> *What is a virus, and why does it depend completely on a living cell?*

::: {.callout-note}
## In preparation
This unit is planned but not yet written. The outline below shows what it will cover.
:::

## Planned content

- Viral structure: genome, capsid and envelope
- Genome types and why they set the replication strategy
- The replication cycle, stage by stage
- Enveloped versus naked viruses

## Planned interactives

- A replication-cycle stepper
- Predict: does hand sanitiser work on this virus?
- Contrast pair: influenza versus the enteroviruses of hand, foot and mouth disease

**Links to other teaching:** Host-cell machinery (cell biology).
